name: Hōkūleʻa wayfinding trial
summary: On Hōkūleʻa's 1980 voyage to Tahiti, navigation by stars, swells and planetarium-learned cues was tested by radioing estimates to an escort boat for comparison.
description: Voyage tested learned wayfinding and planetarium-derived cues; estimates were recorded and radioed to an escort for plotting and comparison.
